A variant language needs a reference language: its manifest is the oracle every tool is scored on, and its tree supplies the source spans.
IT, FR and ES were mapped before DE; any of them can serve as the reference, and DE's own mapping can serve the next language.

Table shapes the tools know about today: fixed-stride rows, struct-of-strings records, easy-chat group chains and u32 word indices. A game with different shapes needs a descriptor, not a new pipeline.
